cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

mechanism: A converts a former pupil scheduling choices into unadmitted tests of whether its teacher comes first.
confusable: A calls each request practical preparation while interpreting answers as judgments of its personal importance.
comparison: Photo-ranking allegiance versus a future move with no flat yet secured.
seedUse: Retain D11 hypothetical moving/phone availability, using S05 lessons in planning to disguise the test and grade its result.
